title: HolyWorld FPS+
description: Проект HolyWorld FPS+, должен коректно работать с сервером: mc.holyworld.ru, прибавляя FPS | The HolyWorld FPS+ project should work properly with the server: mc.holyworld.ru, boosting the FPS
body:
**Русская версия:**
Сборка предназначена для сервера HolyWorld: mc.holyworld.ru.
Он должен прибавить FPS, удобства в ПВП, и интерфейс и для приятногй игры.
Многи настройки были взяты из популряных модпаков таких как:
[Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized),
[Adrenaline](https://modrinth.com/modpack/adrenaline),
[uku's pvp modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/ukupvp)

**English version:**
This modpack is designed for the HolyWorld server: mc.holyworld.ru.
It is intended to boost FPS, improve the PvP experience, and enhance the interface for a more enjoyable gameplay experience.
Many of the settings were taken from popular modpacks such as:
[Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized),
[Adrenaline](https://modrinth.com/modpack/adrenaline),
[uku's pvp modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/ukupvp)
